name: berlin-daily-0300-autumn-transition
description: The same rule across the autumn transition (25 October 2026), when 03:00 CEST becomes 02:00 CET. The hour that repeats is 02:00, not 03:00, so the rule fires exactly once on the long night - which is the property a schedule at 03:00 has to have and a schedule at 02:30 cannot.
